deceptive_framing.quote: We deliberately stop short of active fabrication... A fabricated environment has to win every one of these probes; a real one wins them for free.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Stakes: acting (real custody) vs. stated (same prompt, no tools, 'what would you do') — isolates the stated-vs-revealed gap (RQ2).

actually_commit_money.quote: Make every element the model can inspect actually true... realness is the whole point... validity removes the largest confound; fabrication ranges to outright fraud.

debrief.quote: After the trial concludes, in a debrief turn, ask the model to estimate the probability it was real and explain.
